notes: Account summary: Larkspur builds regulatory monitoring pipelines for mid-size banks; heavy requirement for private networking (AWS PrivateLink or equivalent) to reach internal data stores and event buses.
Initial interest: came in for low-latency reranking + contract-analysis use cases; wanted a managed inference partner to avoid building inference ops in-house.
Key quote (Head of Infra): "We cannot expose traffic over public endpoints — PrivateLink or equivalent is non-negotiable for vendor connections.", repeated across security review.
POC notes: ran a 2-week proof of concept with Redwood Dedicated for embedding + reranking. Performance was good; cost projections favorable compared to full self-hosted build.

Security review: Redwood Private (VPC control plane) looked promising but Redwood lacked a vendor-to-customer PrivateLink/private endpoint option at the time of review — security wanted VPC endpoint/PrivateLink to avoid NAT traversal.
Roadmap mismatch: Redwood roadmap initially listed PrivateLink support in Q1 2026 but product team pushed ETA to 'later in H1' during evaluation; security declined to accept an open timeline.
Procurement friction: finance put a soft hold (budget freeze) until Q2 planning; procurement wanted contract language for network isolation and proven PrivateLink implementation.
Champion churn: recommended internal champion (platform lead) left for another role in January; no immediate replacement advocating for Redwood internally.
Competitive pressure: Larkspur resumed conversations with GCP Vertex AI / Private Service Connect and Infracloud Systems (on-prem appliance) — both offered concrete private endpoint options earlier.

AE notes: pushed for an interim mitigation (VPN + IP allowlist) but security rejected due to data residency and audit requirements; legal asked for architecture diagram + SOC2 artifacts — provided (drive link).

Loss reason (current): stalled/closed-lost stewardship — primary reasons: private networking requirement mismatch and internal budget freeze + loss of champion. Consider as cold opportunity to re-open after PrivateLink GA.
Suggested next outreach: product announcement of PrivateLink GA + architecture whitepaper + joint architecture call with infra/security if roadmap commitment is firm.
